name: Tumble Grove
subtitle: A colourful fruit puzzle
promotionalText: Meet a fresh mix of fruit every round. Stack, merge and discover new varieties, or tilt your phone to send them tumbling around a circular bowl.
description:
A little fruit. A satisfying chain reaction. One more round.

Drop colourful fruit into the basket and bring matching pairs together. Each merge grows a larger fruit, with a gentle reveal that lets you enjoy every step of a cascade. Keep stacking until a fruit spills out.

DISCOVER YOUR NEXT FAVOURITE FRUIT
Explore 110 fruit and variety characters, from familiar favourites to less familiar discoveries. Each round picks a fresh mix across 11 growth levels, favouring a spread of colours. The fruit waiting to drop shows its name, and new merges introduce themselves too. Curious about one already in the basket? Pause with Inspect and tap it to learn its name.

GIVE GRAVITY A TWIST
Play the classic basket, or switch on Gravity mode and tilt your phone to move fruit around a circular bowl. The opening and drop guide turn with gravity.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Enjoy optional sound, light and dark modes, pause controls and reduced-motion support. Challenge your own best score in each mode.

The complete game works offline, with no account, ads or in-app purchases. Best scores and fruit-selection history stay on your device. A fresh launch starts a new round.

Fruit illustrations are playful interpretations. Real fruit sizes vary by variety and growing conditions.
reviewNotes:
Tumble Grove is a complete offline fruit-merging physics game. All game code, fruit artwork and gameplay resources are included in the app; no login, server or additional download is required.

To play, drag across the arena to aim and release to drop a fruit. Identical fruit merge into the next growth level. New rounds select a different lineup from 110 fruit and variety characters. A round ends when a whole fruit spills outside the basket or through the circular bowl opening. Crossing the dotted guide is allowed.

After dropping a fruit, choose Inspect to pause the game, then tap fruit to see their names. Choose Resume to continue. The moon/sun control changes appearance. Sound is optional.

On a physical iPhone, enable Gravity mode and tilt the device to change the direction of gravity. Any requested motion access is used locally for this feature. The classic basket remains playable without motion access.

Best scores, appearance and fruit-selection history are stored locally. The current round is not restored after the app process restarts. There are no ads, in-app purchases, accounts, tracking SDKs or developer-operated gameplay servers. Credits, licences, fruit-size research, the privacy policy and support information are available in Help. These information pages are bundled for offline reading. The support page links to the public GitHub Issues tracker, which opens in the system browser. Posting there requires a GitHub account and internet access; posts are public and users are asked not to share personal or sensitive information.
